statement: The survivor is Morgan Vale, male, Survivor profession, Evacuee scenario, started Spring day 61 at 8:00 in the game
The survivor starts inside government evac shelter B-05, a dark building with a door on its south side leading out to fields
Casey Oglesby, a neutral NPC in the shelter, will share equipment if asked in dialogue (persuasion succeeded) after accepting her request to put down her zombified mother
The shelter's cupboards hold emergency jackets (a cupboard holds 8)
A locker in the shelter holds an emergency blanket, flashlight, light battery, FEMA pamphlet, plastic bottles of clean water (2 units each) and wrapped protein rations
A hostile zombie was spotted about 58 tiles southeast of the shelter; it is slower than the survivor and safe mode is on
Smashing a bench in the shelter yields planks, scrap metal, nuts and bolts and splintered wood
Outside the shelter are fields and forest with a weasel, guineafowl and a squirrel nearby; foraging underbrush there found nothing
The survivor crafted a pointy stick from a plank from memory and wields it as a weapon
An earlier world Isla Vista holds an accidentally created random character, separate from the real survivor in the world Wabuska; it must not be loaded
The survivor's stats are 8 strength, dexterity, intelligence and perception, with an overweight weight limit of 99.2 lbs
The plan is to find sustainable food and clean water and safe gear for long-term survival, while avoiding threats

note: Picked up one emergency jacket from the cupboard
Picked up flashlight, blanket, protein rations and bottle of clean water from the locker
Zombie spotted; safe mode warning, decision whether to engage
Chose to ignore the distant zombie and continue looting
